name: transcribe-en_us-spelling-v1-tiny
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-tiny (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-05. Fine-tune of openai/whisper-tiny (4 encoder + 4 decoder layers, d_model 384, vocab 51,865; 37.76M params) that forces American English spelling in transcripts. Recorded on the strength of the spelling-disambiguation eval set only: WER 3.89% vs the base's 4.93% on Trelis/transcribe-to-en_US-v1, a 30-row synthetic set built from 15 texts x GB/US accents x genders x speeds. CAVEATS: (1) the win is on a 30-sample set the model family was built and tuned for - read the margin as directional at best. (2) On LibriSpeech test.other the model REGRESSES: 12.40% vs the base's 11.62% over 50 rows, and that row is recorded as a regression, not a win. The card presents LibriSpeech deliberately as a degradation check. Licence mit, repo created 2025-12-02.
